issues.detail: The Greek 'τω καθημενω' (to the one sitting) refers to the one *on* the throne, but the Vietnamese translation 'là Đấng ngự trên ngôi' (who is on the throne) attributes the action of sitting to God, whereas the Greek structure suggests 'the salvation [belongs] to the one sitting on the throne of our God'. More importantly, the Vietnamese 'thuộc về' (belongs to) for both parts misses the specific prepositional relationship in the Greek: 'τω καθημενω επι του θρονου' (to the one sitting *on* the throne) and 'τω αρνιω' (to the Lamb).
